cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("Waiting more...")
time.sleep(120)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' 2>&1")
print("Running:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -5 /tmp/docker-build.log 2>&1")
print("Log:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
